name: Ollama
description: Local models for the MaluOS gateway: the release MaluOS pins and checks (maluctl gateway ollama install), the ollama user, a localhost-only service, registered as the gateway's local backend. Pull a model afterwards: sudo maluctl gateway ollama pull llama3.1:8b.
notice: Ollama (MIT) from github.com/ollama/ollama, about 1.5 GB with the GPU libraries; models are downloaded separately.
open: xdg-terminal-exec sh -c 'maluctl gateway ollama status; exec ${SHELL:-bash}'
